item.title: Last Day to Register for Order of the Engineer
item.description: Date: Friday, October 2, 2026 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM - The last day to register for the Order of the Engineer Ceremony is Friday, October 2nd. The ceremony will be October 29th at 7:00 PM. The Order is open to all senior engineering students, or those that have graduated within the past year. You must be present at the ceremony to receive your ring. You may also have your ring sized in the CEE office, JEC 4049 from 9:00 - 3:00 on October 2nd.

item.title: President’s Town Meeting
item.description: Date: Wednesday, October 7, 2026 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM - President’s Town Meeting is an opportunity for students, faculty, and staff to hear updates from President Martin A. Schmidt on the state of the Institute, recent accomplishments, strategic priorities, and future plans. item.title: Computer Science Dissertation Defense - Inwon Kang - Foundational Representations for Tabular Data
item.description: Date: Monday, October 5, 2026 10:00 AM - 11:00 AM - Tables encapsulate rich information in a compact format, making them invaluable for data analysis and decision-making. However, it can be challenging to build a unified method that can effectively leverage the information they contain. This work investigates the necessary ingredients to enable scalable retrieval and understanding of structured data, explored from four perspectives.

item.title: RPI Faculty and Staff Webinar - Strategies on Flipping Your Classroom
item.description:
Date: Monday, October 5, 2026 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM - This session will discuss the practice of moving traditional in-class lectures onto the web by creating engaging, media-rich content that student’s access before, during, or after class. Class time is refocused, allowing students to work on tasks and problems that apply the concepts they studied independently.
